mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(q.id) AS "totalQuestionCount", COUNT(p.question_id) AS "touchedQuestionCount", COUNT(p.question_id) FILTER (WHERE p.mastery_level = 'SOLID') AS "solidQuestionCount", COUNT(p.question_id) FILTER (WHERE p.mastery_level = 'MASTERED') AS "masteredQuestionCount", COUNT(q.id) FILTER (WHERE q.star_level = 5) AS "totalFiveStarQuestionCount", COUNT(p.question_id) FILTER (WHERE q.star_level = 5 AND p.mastery_level IN ('SOLID', 'MASTERED')) AS "solidFiveStarQuestionCount", COUNT(p.question_id) FILTER (WHERE p.wrong_book_active = TRUE) AS "activeWrongQuestionCount", COUNT(f.id) AS "favoriteQuestionCount" FROM question q LEFT JOIN study_progress p ON p.question_id = q.id AND p.profile_id = #{profileId} LEFT JOIN favorite f ON f.target_id = q.id AND f.profile_id = #{profileId} AND f.target_type = 'QUESTION' WHERE q.status = 'ENABLED'

SELECT COUNT(r.id) FROM review_task r JOIN question q ON q.id = r.question_id WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.status = 'PENDING' AND q.status = 'ENABLED' AND r.due_at >= #{start} AND r.due_at < #{end}
SELECT COUNT(r.id) FROM review_task r JOIN question q ON q.id = r.question_id WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.status = 'PENDING' AND q.status = 'ENABLED' AND r.due_at < #{endExclusive}

SELECT q.id AS "questionId", q.title, q.star_level AS "starLevel", p.mastery_level AS "masteryLevel", p.last_studied_at AS "lastStudiedAt" FROM study_progress p JOIN question q ON q.id = p.question_id WHERE p.profile_id = #{profileId} AND q.status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY p.last_studied_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
